Both runs compile the same 7 objects, build the same 6 targets and link 5 times. The probe_source trees are identical (diff -rq).
expired.log: Two classes, no behaviour change. (1) near_sensor_verdict: 124 lines in both runs, all verdict 0 voxel 1. The diagnostic prints the first 120 distinct voxels queried within 0.8 m of the sensor, in query order, so a different planner query order prints a different set. 107 points are printed by both runs and none changed verdict or voxel class (versions/v30/difference_analysis/near_sensor_sets.json). original.log: near_sensor_verdict only: 124 lines in both runs, all verdict 0 voxel 1. 107 points are printed by both runs and none changed (near_sensor_sets.json). original.json, original_queries.csv and original_negatives.json are identical to v29.
v18.log: A* bookkeeping only. Every planner decision and the committed curve are unchanged. (1) The exact-endpoint A* recovers the same full-target connector (3.073 m, cost 3.231 m, tried 11) and the same prefix connector (1.571 m, tried 1). It lists more terminal candidates (173 -> 235 and 172 -> 234), consistent with v30's only change: more layers are Flat or Stair (Unknown -> Flat/Stair only), so more nodes pass the footprint support check. (2) The rebound A* fails in both runs ('A-star failed; aborting optimization', six times in each). In v30 each failed search expands 267 nodes and takes 0.107-0.109 s. That crosses the 0.1 s threshold of the 'A-star path search took' warning, which dyn_a_star.cpp prints only on failure; v29's failed searches ended under 0.1 s. The full-target curve is rejected by the final gate at the same t=5.240 s in both runs, and the fixed-height recovery is not accepted in either. The same reference prefix (3.360 s) is committed with the identical spline (3.768 s, 378 samples). v18.json, v18_queries.csv and v18_negatives.json are identical to v29.
v23.log: Planner-path changes before the same committed result. Both runs time out the goal-neighbourhood A* (0.2 s wall budget) and use the same reference frontier and goal neighbour (-5.295,1.705,1.033). The second seed point moves from (-5.295,4.747) to (-5.345,4.761), because the A* seed path sees v30's labels. In v29 the full-target optimization aborted inside the rebound ('A-star error', rebound_no_valid_new_constraints). In v30 it succeeds (31 iterations, cost 0.291) and passes the minimum-cruise check on its second attempt. The unchanged final full-curve gate then rejects it: final_spline_rejected status=1 (Collision) at t=4.955 s of 5.854 s, 497 samples. In both runs the fixed-height recovery optimizes (v29: 30 iterations, cost 2.854; v30: 28 iterations, cost 2.672), fails the minimum-cruise check and is not accepted (fixed_height_recovery_result accepted=0). Both runs then commit the identical reference prefix (2.625 s; spline 3.466 s, 348 samples, the same control points). v23.json, v23_queries.csv and v23_negatives.json are identical to v29.
v23_repeat.log: The same classes as v23.log, plus one wall-time-dependent line. The goal-neighbourhood A* has a 0.2 s wall-time budget. In v29's repeat, and in both runs' v23.log, the first search timed out and the planner used the reference frontier. In v30's repeat it finished in time and printed a first goal neighbour (-5.186,1.712,1.052; 64 path points). Later calls then printed the same neighbour as v29 (-5.295,1.705,1.033). Within v30, v23.log timed out and v23_repeat.log did not, on identical inputs, so this line depends on wall time, not on the label change. The committed prefix is identical. v23_repeat.json equals v29's v23_repeat.json and v30's v23.json.
v26.log: The planner path behind the v26.json change (difference_explanations.json['v26']). In v29 the full 3.675 s local target failed the first optimize step twice, normal and fixed-height ('The robot is inside an obstacle', 'First three control points are in obstacles' at (-5.6,6,0.34) to (-5.5,5.8,0.41)); reference-prefix halving then committed 1.8375 s. In v30 the same target optimizes in 32 iterations (cost 0.384), passes the unchanged full-curve gate (6.500 s, 652 samples) and commits 3.675 s. The verified direct-seed shortcut starts from 73 instead of 81 original nodes. [FIXED_START_YAW] at yaw -1.994691 goes 1 -> 0: the front footprint circle's centre cell (14,142), layer 0.058 m, is Unknown in v29 and Flat in v30. The support check alone predicts every printed fixed-yaw value in both runs (versions/v30/difference_analysis/fixed_yaw_support.json). Yaw 2.54264767 stays 1 because its front centre cell (13,144) has no unambiguous layer within 0.26 m of the body ground in either version. near_sensor_verdict: 124 lines in both runs, all verdict 0 voxel 1; 56 points are printed by both and none changed (near_sensor_sets.json).
v26_repeat.log: Identical difference classes and counts to v26.log, with the same explanation. fixed_yaw_support.json and near_sensor_sets.json cover the repeat separately and agree.
